title: config/color-schemes/<name>.yaml and the operator's color-schemes/<name>.yaml
description: One color scheme (views.md, D-470 to D-474; F-138 D2): a map from a style name to the Node `util.styleText` formats of that style, for example `match: [bold, '#f9e2af']`. `match` is required, because the renderer applies it to the text that a search pattern matches (D-469).
